widget.name: Duplicate Finder & Merge
widget.short_description: Find and merge duplicate contacts, companies and leads
widget.description: The widget finds and merges duplicate contacts, companies and leads in amoCRM. Managed from settings: flexible search rules (field combinations with AND/OR), value normalization (phones, emails, tax IDs, names), mass base cleanup and automatic rule-based merging with rollback.
